details:
UI change feedback

New nameplates are not it. they feel significantly blander, and like a step back compared to the current ones. no longer having the text itself be yellow for friends is pretty jarring and quite a bit harder to distinguish. they should just be left as they are.

the side bar friends list is a pretty bad change aswell, it feels like there is so much wasted space, and user profile pictures are absolutely tiny, aswell as the uniform grey background making everything feel boring. please keep the current stable friends list, its the best use of the space and looks appealing while staying readable. noone has had any issues with it.

the main profile UI is.. something. 

please do not hide the bio behind a read more button. it is more clicks for no reason, the scrolling has worked amazing forever and felt more intuitive and flows better. 

the design itself is alright but its stuck between old and new, and the mix feels weird and super unintuitive. its a new UI with old user management buttons. the old buttons and menu work and look great, the new menu works and looks.. okay. it would be alot better with matching buttons or just not being changed at all. 

overall, i would prefer it not be changed at all. but if it was, i hope this feedback is taken into account.
title: New UI feedback.
